violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. The establishment has employees certified through an approved food safety management course. One of these employees must register with RIDOH Center for Food Protection as the Certified Food Safety Manager. Application provided. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/08/2025

Ambient temperature of the cold drawer unit was observed held at 47 degrees Fahrenheit. Sausage observed with a temperature of 43 degrees F. Sausage had been pulled from the walk-in cooler less than 2 hours ago. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. TCS foods were moved to the walk-in cooler. No TCS foods are to be stored in this unit until it is maintaining a consistent temperature at/below 41 degrees F. New Violation. Correct By: 11/23/2026

The floor and wall junctures around the walk-in cooler and walk-in freezer do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. Coving must be installed. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 01/01/2024

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment has employees that have successfully completed an approved course in food safety management. One employee must register with RIDOH Center for Food Protection as the Certified Food Safety Manager. Application provided. New Violation. Correct By: 12/08/2025
The hand-washing sink at the counter was lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/01/2025

Sanitizer bucket was stored with food, equipment, utensils, or single service items. Chemicals must be stored to prevent the contamination of clean equipment, utensils linens, and/or single service by locating them in an area that is not above/beside food, equipment utensils, linens, and single service articles. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/01/2025

Working container of sugar observed not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/01/2025

The floor and wall junctures around the walk-in cooler and walk-in freezer do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 01/01/2024

Sanitizer was stored with food, equipment, utensils, or single service items. Chemicals must be stored to prevent the contamination of clean equipment, utensils linens, and/or single service by spacing or partitioning and locating them in an area that is not above food, equipment utensils, linens, and single service articles. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/02/2024
